bodies: Accreditation Council for Accountancy and Taxation (ACAT)
National Association of Certified Valuators and Analysts (NACVA)

exams.name: CPA Exam Auditing and Attestation Section
exams.blurb: Core CPA Examination section covering ethics, audit engagement planning, evidence gathering, internal control and attestation reporting.

exams.name: CPA Exam Business Analysis and Reporting Discipline
exams.blurb: CPA discipline section on advanced financial reporting, data analysis, managerial accounting and state and local government accounting.

exams.name: CPA Exam Financial Accounting and Reporting Section
exams.blurb: Core CPA Examination section covering the financial reporting framework, financial statement accounts and select transactions.

exams.name: CPA Exam Information Systems and Controls Discipline
exams.blurb: CPA discipline section on IT governance, information systems, security, confidentiality and system and organisation control engagements.

exams.name: CPA Exam Tax Compliance and Planning Discipline
exams.blurb: CPA discipline section on advanced individual and entity tax compliance, personal financial planning and entity planning transactions.

exams.name: CPA Exam Taxation and Regulation Section
exams.blurb: Core CPA Examination section covering federal taxation of individuals and entities, business law and professional responsibilities.

exams.name: Annual Filing Season Program Record of Completion
exams.blurb: Voluntary annual programme for unenrolled preparers requiring continuing education and a six-hour federal tax refresher course and test.

exams.name: IRS Certifying Acceptance Agent Training
exams.blurb: Mandatory forensic document and ITIN training for agents authorised to certify identity documents for taxpayer identification applications.

exams.name: Special Enrollment Examination Part 1: Individuals
exams.blurb: First enrolled agent paper covering individual taxpayer preliminary work, income, deductions, credits, specialised returns and advising.

exams.name: Special Enrollment Examination Part 2: Businesses
exams.blurb: Second enrolled agent paper covering business entities, business financial information, and specialised returns for trusts and estates.

exams.name: Special Enrollment Examination Part 3: Representation, Practices and Procedures
exams.blurb: Third enrolled agent paper covering practitioner requirements, representation before the IRS, filing procedures and Circular 230 ethics.

exams.name: Accredited in Business Valuation Credential
exams.blurb: Valuation specialty credential examination covering engagement acceptance, valuation approaches, discounts and reporting standards.

exams.name: Certified in Entity and Intangible Valuations Credential
exams.blurb: Fair value credential for valuing entities and intangible assets in financial reporting, with mandatory performance framework compliance.

exams.name: Certified in Financial Forensics Credential
exams.blurb: Forensic accounting specialty credential covering fraud prevention, investigation techniques, damages calculation and expert testimony.

exams.name: Personal Financial Specialist Credential
exams.blurb: Personal financial planning credential for CPAs, covering retirement, estate, insurance, investment and tax planning integration.

exams.name: Certified Government Auditing Professional
exams.blurb: Specialty certification for public-sector internal auditors covering government audit standards, performance auditing and accountability.

exams.name: Certified Internal Auditor Part 1: Essentials of Internal Auditing
exams.blurb: First CIA paper covering internal audit mandate, independence, objectivity, proficiency, governance, risk management and fraud risks.

exams.name: Certified Internal Auditor Part 2: Practice of Internal Auditing
exams.blurb: Second CIA paper covering engagement planning, fieldwork supervision, working papers, communication of results and follow-up.

exams.name: Certified Internal Auditor Part 3: Business Knowledge for Internal Auditing
exams.blurb: Third CIA paper covering business acumen, information security, IT controls, financial management and data analytics.

exams.name: Accredited Business Accountant/Advisor
exams.body: Accreditation Council for Accountancy and Taxation (ACAT)
aka: Comprehensive Examination for Accreditation in Accountancy
exams.blurb: Two-part accreditation examination covering financial accounting, reporting, taxation and business law for small-business practitioners.

exams.name: Accredited Tax Advisor
exams.body: Accreditation Council for Accountancy and Taxation (ACAT)
exams.blurb: Credential for practitioners handling sophisticated tax planning, covering retirement, estate, business and multi-year tax strategy.

exams.name: Accredited Tax Preparer
exams.body: Accreditation Council for Accountancy and Taxation (ACAT)
exams.blurb: Entry-level tax accreditation examination covering individual return preparation, deductions, credits and preparer ethics.

exams.name: Accredited Member Business Valuation Designation
exams.blurb: First-tier business valuation designation requiring principles of valuation coursework, examinations and two years of experience.

exams.name: Accredited Senior Appraiser in Business Valuation
exams.blurb: Senior business valuation designation requiring valuation examinations, a submitted report review and five years of full-time practice.

exams.name: Certified Payroll Professional
exams.blurb: Senior payroll certification covering wage and hour law, taxation, benefits, payroll systems, accounting and management practice.

exams.name: Fundamental Payroll Certification
exams.blurb: Entry-level payroll credential covering core payroll concepts, compliance, calculations and payroll systems with no experience requirement.

exams.name: Certified Valuation Analyst Exam
exams.body: National Association of Certified Valuators and Analysts (NACVA)
exams.blurb: Business valuation certification requiring a proctored examination plus a case study or sanitised valuation report submission.

exams.name: Master Analyst in Financial Forensics Exam
exams.body: National Association of Certified Valuators and Analysts (NACVA)
exams.blurb: Financial forensics credential with a core examination plus a specialty track such as commercial damages or bankruptcy and insolvency.

exams.name: CMA Part 1: Financial Planning, Performance and Analytics
exams.blurb: First CMA paper covering external reporting, planning and budgeting, performance management, cost management and internal controls.

exams.name: CMA Part 2: Strategic Financial Management
exams.blurb: Second CMA paper covering financial statement analysis, corporate finance, decision analysis, risk management and professional ethics.

exams.name: Intuit Academy Tax Exam
exams.blurb: Free training and assessment pathway in individual tax preparation used as a hiring route into remote seasonal tax preparer roles.

exams.name: QuickBooks Online Certified ProAdvisor Exam
exams.blurb: Product certification testing QuickBooks Online setup, banking, reporting and client management for bookkeepers and accounting firms.

exams.name: Enrolled Agent (Special Enrollment Examination)
exams.blurb: The IRS credential granting unlimited representation rights, earned by passing all three parts of the Special Enrollment Examination.

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.blurb: Three Core sections plus one Discipline section under CPA Evolution, taken alongside the 150-credit-hour education requirement.

exams.name: Certified Bookkeeper
exams.blurb: Four-part national bookkeeping certification covering adjusting entries, error correction, payroll, depreciation and inventory.

exams.name: Certified Defense Financial Manager Examinations
exams.blurb: Three-module certification covering defence resource management, budget and cost analysis, and accounting and finance for DoD comptrollers.

exams.name: Certified Fraud Examiner Exam
exams.blurb: Four-section examination on financial transactions and fraud schemes, law, investigation techniques and fraud prevention and deterrence.

exams.name: Certified Government Financial Manager Examinations
exams.blurb: Three-examination programme covering the governmental environment, government accounting and reporting, and financial management and control.
